records.jp: く～！　このサークル机、<CR>いつ見てもテンション上がるなあ！
records.en_original: I never get tired of looking at this stuff!
records.en: I never get tired of looking at this stuff!

records.jp: 分かる……<CR>この胸の高鳴り、止められない
records.en_original: Agreed. It gets your heart racing, doesn't it?
records.en: Agreed. It gets your heart racing, doesn't it?

records.jp: 愛央はどんな同人誌が好き？
records.en_original: What kind of comics do you like, Ao?
records.en: What kind of comics do you like, Ao?

records.jp: 漫画やアニメの同人誌かな！<CR>自分の好きなキャラが出てると買うよね
records.en_original: Probably manga or anime ones. I mean, who doesn't want more stories of their favorite characters?
records.en: Probably manga or anime ones. I mean, who doesn't want more stories of their favorite characters?

records.jp: 推しが尊いシーンは、多少の犠牲が伴っても<CR>見逃せない
records.en_original: It's worth the cost to see your ship interact.
records.en: It's worth the cost to see your ship interact.

records.jp: ほんと、それな！
records.en_original: Exactly!
records.en: Exactly!

records.jp: 二次創作も良いけど、<CR>オリジナルの同人誌も好きかな！
records.en_original: Hmm, I like fan comics, but original indie comics are where it's at.
records.en: Hmm, I like fan comics, but original indie comics are where it's at.

records.jp: 作者さんの愛が溢れてる作品とか<CR>めっちゃいいよねー！
records.en_original: You can really feel the author's passion.
records.en: You can really feel the author's passion.

records.jp: うん。その人にしか生み出せない世界は<CR>特別で魅力的だと思う
records.en_original: The worlds and stories they create are quite unique.
records.en: The worlds and stories they create are quite unique.

records.jp: 何にも縛られず、自由に自分を表現している。<CR>……そんな作品に、きららも惹かれる
records.en_original: Unbound by anything but their own imagination... I enjoy them as well.
records.en: Unbound by anything, freely expressing themselves... Kirara is drawn to works like that too.

records.jp: そういえば、きららは<CR>どういうジャンルが好きなんだっけ？
records.en_original: So what kind of genres do you like, Kirara?
records.en: So what kind of genres do you like, Kirara?

records.jp: 商業同人、ジャンル問わず。誰かの手によって<CR>生み出されたものに、ロマンを感じる
records.en_original: All genres and all mediums. I'm interested in anything creative.
records.en: All genres and all mediums. I'm interested in anything creative.

records.jp: 創作物なら、なんでもってこと？
records.en_original: So you'll read anything as long as it's fiction?
records.en: So you'll read anything as long as it's fiction?

records.jp: イエス、オフコース
records.en_original: Quite right.
records.en: Quite right.

records.jp: 人の知的労力による産物……それはすなわち<CR>芸術と呼ぶにふさわしい
records.en_original: Any product of human creativity and hard work is worth calling art.
records.en: Any product of human creativity and hard work is worth calling art.

records.jp: さすが、サブカル女子。<CR>でも、つまりそれって……
records.en_original: Wow, that's pretty open-minded. So, what you're saying is...
records.en: Wow, that's pretty open-minded. So, what you're saying is...

records.jp: 私の創作物も、きららにとっては芸術ってこと？
records.en_original: You'd consider anything I create to be art?
records.en: You'd consider anything I create to be art?

records.jp: そういうこと
records.en_original: Indeed.
records.en: Indeed.

records.jp: でも、見てみないと芸術かどうか判断できないから<CR>見せてほしい
records.en_original: Though I can't make a firm statement without seeing the piece first.
records.en: Though I can't make a firm statement without seeing the piece first.

records.jp: い、今のは、たとえ話だよ！<CR>私は見る専だし！
records.en_original: Th-that was just a hypothetical! I'll stick with just reading.
records.en: Th-that was just a hypothetical! I'll stick with just reading.

records.jp: なんだ、残念……
records.en_original: That's too bad...
records.en: That's too bad...

records.jp: 好きなものがたくさんあるってことだね
records.en_original: You must be a fan of a lot of stuff then.
records.en: You must be a fan of a lot of stuff then.

records.jp: そうでもない
records.en_original: Not exactly.
records.en: Not exactly.

records.jp: そうでもないの！？
records.en_original: Not exactly?!
records.en: Not exactly?!

records.jp: すべての創作に、アガペーとロマンが<CR>あるわけじゃない
records.en_original: Not all works contain an inherent romantic or altruistic element.
records.en: Not all works contain an inherent romantic or altruistic element.

records.jp: アガペーとロマン……
records.en_original: Uh...huh...
records.en: Uh...huh...

records.jp: うむ。作品にはその二つが必要不可欠
records.en_original: For me, art is inextricably linked to these two things...
records.en: For me, art is inextricably linked to these two things...

records.jp: そして、寝ながら楽しめるとなお良い
records.en_original: Being able to enjoy it in bed before sleeping is important as well.
records.en: Being able to enjoy it in bed before sleeping is important as well.

records.jp: そういうきららは<CR>自分で作ったりしてなかったの？
records.en_original: What about you, Kirara? Do you write or draw anything yourself?
records.en: What about you, Kirara? Do you write or draw anything yourself?

records.en_original: Uhh...
records.en: Uhh...

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Uhh?
records.en: Uhh?

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと待って、なにその反応！<CR>絶対、なんか作ってるよね！？
records.en_original: Whoa, whoa, what's up with that reaction?! You totally do, don't you?!
records.en: Whoa, whoa, what's up with that reaction?! You totally do, don't you?!

records.jp: きららは貝になる
records.en_original: Is there a hole around I can bury myself in?
records.en: Kirara will become a clam.

records.jp: いや、ならないで！　気になるから！<CR>それってもしかして……
records.en_original: No, don't do that! Tell me! Wait, do you draw...
records.en: No, don't do that! Tell me! Wait, do you draw...

records.jp: オリジナル小説とか？
records.en_original: Original stuff?
records.en: Original stuff?

records.jp: ……ほっ
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: 何今の、「ほっ」ていうのは
records.en_original: What do you mean, "phew"?
records.en: What do you mean, "phew"?

records.jp: なんでもない
records.en_original: Nothing in particular.
records.en: Nothing in particular.

records.jp: もしかして、もっとすごいやつ？
records.en_original: You mean you make stuff even cooler than that?
records.en: You mean you make stuff even cooler than that?

records.jp: ねえ、教えてよ！
records.en_original: C'mon, tell me!
records.en: C'mon, tell me!

records.jp: あ、集合の合図が聞こえた
records.en_original: Ah, I think someone's calling for me.
records.en: Ah, I think someone's calling for me.

records.jp: きらら～！！
records.en_original: Kiraraaaa!
records.en: Kiraraaaa!

records.jp: 同人誌とか？
records.en_original: ...Fan fiction?
records.en: ...Fan fiction?

records.jp: どきり……
records.en_original: Whuh-oh...
records.en: Whuh-oh...

records.jp: あっ、今、どきりって言った！
records.en_original: I heard that!
records.en: I heard that!

records.jp: 言ってない
records.en_original: You heard nothing.
records.en: You heard nothing.

records.jp: ねえねえ、どんなの作ったの！？<CR>教えて、教えて！
records.en_original: You gotta tell me everything! What are they about, huh?!
records.en: You gotta tell me everything! What are they about, huh?!

records.jp: お子様にはまだ早い
records.en_original: I'll tell you when you're older.
records.en: I'll tell you when you're older.

records.jp: いや、きららも同い年だから！
records.en_original: But we're the same age!
records.en: But we're the same age!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
